svg.title: Thirty-One Direction Fugue
svg.desc: Thirty-one rotated families exceed the usual maximum 16. Needles of length 4.9 cross a starting triangle 6.4 units wide; both sizes exceed the controls. Their overlapping finite Kakeya-inspired construction becomes a many-direction pressure field in a single ink. Native toolbar flow: nested rect echoes → directional planes, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
